US.description: Includes federal income tax, an estimated average for state income tax, and FICA (Social Security and Medicare) contributions.

IN.description: Includes central income tax and a 4% health and education cess.

SG.description: Progressive personal income tax applied to an $85k USD earner (approx. S$115k), with no capital gains tax

CH.description: Effective rate includes federal, cantonal, and communal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions (AHV/IV/EO/ALV). Rates vary significantly by canton and commune; this is an approximate average.

NL.description: Effective income tax rate for an $85k USD earner, including national income tax (Box 1) and social security contributions.

GB.description: Includes income tax and National Insurance contributions.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes, along with mandatory payroll contributions like Canada Pension Plan (CPP) and Employment Insurance (EI). This rate is an estimate for an $85k USD earner in Ontario, which is roughly $115k CAD.

AE.description: The UAE has no personal income tax for individuals.

NO.description: Includes national income tax, municipal tax, county tax, and national insurance contributions.

IE.description: Effective tax rate includes Irish Income Tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for a single earner.

LU.description: Includes progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions for a single earner.

AU.description: Effective tax rate includes federal income tax and Medicare levy, calculated for an $85k USD earner (approx. $127.5k AUD) in Australia.

QA.description: No personal income tax for residents

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam has no personal income tax.

MO.description: Income tax, which features a generous tax-exempt threshold and progressive rates that cap at 12% for the highest brackets.
